title: Degenerating orbits of the Longest Edge Bisection process
summary: We study the Longest Edge Bisection (LEB) process as a dynamical system on the projective shape space of simplices. A long-standing conjecture going back to Adler and Rivara-Levin and motivated by finite-element mesh refinement, often taken as a standing assumption, is that this procedure is non-degenerate and, in fact, in a certain way periodic.
